lede.zh: MiniMax-H3 在 8 张 Ascend 910B4 上完成 1344×768、24 fps、约 5.21 秒视频生成。50 步端到端耗时两次为 458.4 秒与 456.5 秒，输出视频逐字节一致。
lede.en: MiniMax-H3 generated a 1344×768, 24 fps, 5.21-second video on eight Ascend 910B4 accelerators. Two 50-step end-to-end runs took 458.4 s and 456.5 s and produced byte-identical video.

heading.zh: 生成链路跑通，正式版仍有适配缺口
heading.en: Generation works on the tested branch; upstream release still has integration gaps

intro.zh: A2 分支版本完成真实视频生成；50 步重复运行耗时差 0.4%。该实验验证的是经过临时 Ascend 适配的 SGLang 分支，不能视为 SGLang 0.5.17 正式版直接可用。
intro.en: The A2 branch completed real video generation; the two 50-step runs differed by 0.4%. This validates a temporarily adapted SGLang branch, not out-of-the-box support in SGLang 0.5.17.

note.zh: 总耗时含约 132–135 秒去噪之外的阶段（VAE 解码、音频处理和封装），不等同于纯 NPU 推理耗时。
note.en: End-to-end time includes about 132–135 s outside denoising (VAE decode, audio processing, and packaging); it is not pure NPU inference time.

heading.zh: 两次生成耗时稳定在约 457 秒
heading.en: Two runs complete in about 457 seconds

intro.zh: 负载为 5 秒目标视频、1344×768、24 fps、50 步。两次 run 的生成总计分别为 458.4 秒和 456.5 秒。
intro.en: The workload used a 5-second target video, 1344×768 resolution, 24 fps, and 50 steps. The two runs took 458.4 s and 456.5 s end to end.

notes.zh: 去噪阶段分别为 323.70 秒和 324.22 秒，约 6.6 秒/步。
notes.en: Denoising took 323.70 s and 324.22 s, or about 6.6 s per step.

notes.zh: 去噪之外尾段约 132–135 秒，主要包括 VAE 解码、音频处理与视频封装。
notes.en: The outside-denoising tail is about 132–135 s, including VAE decode, audio processing, and video packaging.

hint.zh: 两次重复 run；越低耗时越短。
hint.en: Two repeated runs; lower is faster.

heading.zh: 固定 seed 下结果可复现，媒体格式通过校验
heading.en: Output is reproducible at fixed seed and passes media validation

intro.zh: 两次 50 步输出逐字节一致。媒体检查确认 H.264 视频为 1344×768、24 fps、124 帧，包含 AAC 立体声音频，时长约 5.21 秒。
intro.en: The two 50-step outputs were byte-identical. Media inspection confirmed H.264 at 1344×768, 24 fps, and 124 frames, with AAC stereo audio and a duration of about 5.21 s.

notes.zh: 抽帧人工检查与提示词“人物在海中游泳”一致。
notes.en: A sampled frame was reviewed and matched the prompt describing a person swimming in the ocean.

notes.zh: 固定 seed 重复验证不代表跨提示词的画质质量评测。
notes.en: Fixed-seed repeats do not constitute a quality evaluation across prompts.

heading.zh: 结果来自临时 Ascend 分支，适配状态必须随数据说明
heading.en: Results use a temporary Ascend branch; its status is part of the result

intro.zh: 使用 SGLang 0.5.17 的 Ascend 专用临时分支，SP8 + Ulysses8；启用 Ascend Flash Attention，关闭 Cache-DiT，VAE 使用 CPU offload。
intro.en: The run used a temporary Ascend-specific branch based on SGLang 0.5.17 with SP8 + Ulysses8; Ascend Flash Attention enabled, Cache-DiT disabled, and VAE CPU offload.

notes.zh: 正式版 SGLang 0.5.17 的去噪链路仍被 Ascend 设备判断与 packed-varlen attention 接口缺口阻断；本结果依赖分支适配。
notes.en: The stock SGLang 0.5.17 denoising path remained blocked by Ascend device checks and a packed-varlen-attention interface gap; this result depends on branch patches.

notes.zh: 样本量 n=2，仅列两次原始值，不报告尾部分位数，也不声称统计稳定性。
notes.en: At n=2, the report lists both raw values and makes no tail-percentile or statistical-stability claim.

notes.zh: 已移除内部节点地址、镜像仓库、集群配置和模型挂载路径。
notes.en: Internal node addresses, image registry, cluster configuration, and model mount paths have been removed.

rows: 50 步 n=2；4 步 smoke n=1

methodIntro.zh: 分别记录端到端生成时间、去噪阶段时间并核验输出。正式版未适配路径与临时分支路径需区分。
methodIntro.en: End-to-end and denoising-phase time were recorded separately and outputs validated. Stock release behavior must be distinguished from the temporary branch.

methodNotes.zh: 本报告描述视频生成任务，不是文本生成吞吐测试。
methodNotes.en: This report describes video generation, not text-generation throughput.
